title: generator's in
description: What the main conversation gives the generator: its Cut as it starts, and the main conversation's grounds as it resumes it. tree.py's code gives the Cut, through the adapter of a start's text, and the guard limits the generator's calls to its run values.

start.description: The Cut, one JSON object on the first line of the prompt that starts the generator: its run values, and the part of the design tree it makes the deliverable from.

record.description: The path of the start's record, a file in the run's records/ that the role writes only by record.py, in the form of record.schema.json, and that rn's check reads at the role's end.

deliverable.description: The path of the deliverable it makes, from the top of rn's worktree.

kind.description: The deliverable's kind, such as readme.

best_practice.description: The folder of the best practice of the deliverable's kind.

refactor.description: The folder of the refactor best practice that it finishes by, of documents or of code.

made.description: The path of the file in the round where it writes its Made, in the form of generator-out.schema.json's made.

cut.description: The part of the design tree it starts with, and nothing else of it.

goal.description: The goal, as the user confirmed it.

name.description: The one thing that holds toward the goal once the deliverable exists.

inputs.description: The path of each deliverable this one takes its content from.

done_at.description: The ID of the commit at which the deliverable was last done, so that the generator reworking it reads each input's change since then, not each input whole. Absent where it was never done.

decisions.description: Each decision of the deliverable's necessary conditions, by its condition's ID.

decision.description: A decision of the design tree that the role carries out, by its path, as the design tree best practice gives its form.

more.description: Each More kept from the last round, which the round makes good where the decision it changed lands.

best_practice.description: The kind of the best practice whose necessary condition it falls short of, the deliverable's kind or that of the refactor best practice, as the two share condition IDs.

decision.description: The decision it changed, by its path in the design tree.

step.description: The step it stood at, where a paused run picks up, from the start's Place. Absent at a start anew.

resume.description: The message by which the main conversation resumes the role with SendMessage: its first line, then its decision on the role's last result and why, and, where the person answered, a line that opens the person's words as they wrote them, as a summary loses what the person meant.
